First the relief: nine days, 25 outings, 25 candles, like so many trading sessions. Then the grade: each outing is rated on the official Norwegian scale (DNT, four levels).

The wick runs from the lowest to the highest point: an out-and-back summit gives a flat body and a long wick. Below, the D+: solid bar without the pack, light with it.

Pour mesurer la surprise, il faut un éta: To measure surprise, you need a yardstick. Mine: Tobler’s rule, which gives walking speed by slope, recalibrated on my average pace with and without the pack. On each 250 m segment, how far do I stray from it?

z compte l’écart en σ : à z = 3, une loi: z counts the deviation in σ: at z = 3, a normal distribution produces only one segment in 740 on that side. “Time”: ×3.5 means three and a half times the expected time. Blue dot: with the pack; orange: on trail.

Chaque massif part du niveau de la mer e: Each massif starts at sea level and comes back to it: between two summits, you come down to the edge of a fjord, a road or a village. The traverse is a sequence of 15 short, independent climbs, each with its own way out.
Propre à un massif : un pierrier, un sen: Specific to one massif: scree, an invisible trail, a rock band. It says nothing about the next massif.
Commun à tous les massifs du moment : la: Shared by all the massifs of the moment: the weather. No return to sea level wipes it out.

Une régression sur les 604 tronçons isol: A regression on the 604 segments isolates the effect of each factor, all else being equal. Each bar gives the change in time taken, with its 95% confidence interval.
Effet marginal sur le temps d’un tronçon: Marginal effect on the time of a segment
Une barre à droite de zéro ralentit, une: A bar to the right of zero slows down, a bar to the left speeds up. If the whisker crosses zero, the effect cannot be told apart from chance (n.s.). In the matrix, red = both factors rise together, blue = one rises when the other falls.
Moindres carrés ordinaires sur ln(temps: Ordinary least squares on ln(actual time / Tobler), with slope (absolute value: up or down), pack, terrain grade, gusts, HRV of the previous night and steep descent (> 15%). Effects converted into %: e
La régression ne trouve aucun effet de l: The regression finds no effect of fatigue on pace. Yet fatigue exists. Heart rate variability (HRV), measured every night, reflects recovery: 0% is an ordinary night (45 ms, my usual value outside the traverse). Below, the length of each night.

La ligne pointillée (0 %) est la VFC hab: The dotted line (0%) is the usual HRV; the grey band, the normal zone at ±10%. In green, above usual; in red, below. A curve that stays under the band signals fatigue building up.

À gauche, l’aire rouge mesure l’excédent: On the left, the red area measures the excess of rain over the normal, the blue area the deficit. On the right, the days above the reference line had stronger gusts than the usual maximum gust for the period.

Un cumul ne dit pas tout : les jours de: A total does not tell everything: fine days come together, and so do rainy ones. The real question is whether I hit a rare week, an exceptional rain episode, or simply a favourable calendar.
À gauche, la chance qu’il pleuve un jour: On the left, the chance of rain on a given day, depending on whether it rained the day before. If days were independent, the two bars would be equal. On the right, each histogram sorts 1,200 nine-day windows drawn from the summers of 1996–2025; the red bar is the 2026 bin, and the percentile says what share of windows does less.
ERA5 (Open-Meteo), point centre, pluie q: ERA5 (Open-Meteo), central point, daily rain from 1996 to 2025. A rainy day gets at least 1 mm. Persistence measured over the 1,800 day-to-day transitions in June and July. Nine-day windows, like the traverse, with a start every day from 1 June to 10 July: 30 summers × 40 dates = 1,200 windows, the same as in parts 07 and 09.

En finance, les « grecs » mesurent comme: In finance, the “Greeks” measure how the price of an option reacts to each of its inputs. This conclusion takes up the measurements of act 2 and pairs each one with its Greek: each letter asks a question about what moves my time, and by how much.
Chaque carte : la question « de combien: Each card: the “how much” question, then the measurement on the 604 segments. The “?” gives the definition in finance. “n.s.”: effect indistinguishable from chance.
